dct_title_s: Plan of Cape Town, Cape of Good Hope
dct_description_sm: Map also appears in A. H. Honikman's book: Cape Town, City of Good Hope (1966). Includes "forty-four numbered references to places existing at that time in the town and its surroundings. "

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0343, p. 392
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0343.
